recent.text: Carbery on Stevenson recall: “Clay coming up with the roster spot opening (Kyrou to IR) is our opportunity to get him here. We haven’t seen him in a while. He’s been in Winnipeg. Let’s see what he’s learned. Let’s see how he looks. That’s just the reason why.”
